changes: Kept all extracted content; expanded notes on the conflicting year (797 vs 787) and on the probable instrumental form of the scribe's name

notes: The two figures for the year do not agree. Bendall's physical description gives 'N. S. 797 (A.D. 1677)', but his Devanāgarī excerpt of the colophon prints 'संवत् ७८७' (NS 787 = 1667 CE). One of them is probably a misprint, and I can't tell which. I followed the colophon as printed (787 / 1667); if the heading is right, the year is NS 797 = 1677 CE. Bendall leaves out the month, nakṣatra and day. 'श्रीयो ऽसु' is probably a garbled 'श्रेयो ऽस्तु'. Bendall puts a query (?) after the scribe's name. 'रत्नवज्रिण' probably stands for the instrumental Ratnavajriṇā, after 'likhitaṃ'. I took the stem as Ratnavajrin; Ratnavajra is also possible. 'Kāṣṭhamaṇḍapa-nagara' is Kathmandu.
